applies_to: Belimo general-purpose damper and valve actuators with the BACnet MS/TP interface (rotary, linear and fail-safe types).
summary: Belimo's air/water actuators with a communication interface can run on BACnet MS/TP. The BMS writes a % setpoint to AO 1, scaled between Min and Max, and reads position and status; one extra sensor input (active, passive temperature or switch) can be read over the bus. The setpoint can also come from a 0-10 V signal, chosen with SpSource (MV 122).
notes: The document's PICS prints the model numbers as ..M(C)24A-MOD, ..R24A-MOD, ..V(K)24A-MOD, ..F24A-MOD and ..RF24A-MOD with application software 'Modbus Module V1.0'; check the actuator's own datasheet for the exact BACnet part number.
AbsPos reads in degrees on rotary actuators and mm on linear ones.
Sens1Analog has no fixed unit: V, ohm, °C or °F depending on Sens1Type.
AV 131 / AV 132 only apply to electronic fail-safe actuators.
StatusActuator states 2 and 4 stay set until reset with Command (MV 120) = Reset.

integration.summary: Set MV 122 SpSource to Bus and command AO 1 SpRel. Read AI 1 position and BI 101 summary status. If a bus watchdog is set in AV 130, keep writing AO 1 (or MO 1) within that time.

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint: Analog (1, default) follows the 0-10 V signal on wire 3; Bus (2) uses AO 1. MO 1 Override can force Open, Close, Min, Mid, Max or fast open/close.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 Bus Watchdog (0-3600 s, default 0 = off). When set, each write to AO 1 or MO 1 restarts the timer; on timeout the AO 1 priority array is cleared, the relinquish default applies, and MI 110 shows Bus Watchdog triggered. With SpSource = Analog only MO 1 writes are tracked.
setup: Max 32 nodes without repeater; 120 ohm termination set with the configuration tool (BI 99 shows it).
Quick addressing with the Address and Adaption buttons; configure with Belimo Assistant 2.
gotchas: Persistent writable objects are not meant to be written on a regular basis.
Fast open / fast close overrides add mechanical wear; keep them for time-critical events such as frost protection.
Max 6 active COV subscriptions, lifetime up to 8 hours.
